rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE THE TEACHING OF BASIC COMPUTER PROGRAMMING AS PART OF THE CURRICULUM OF ALL SECONDARY SCHOOLS IN THE COUNTRY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the inclusion of basic computer programming courses in the curriculum of all high schools in the country to make the youth computer literate.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE NATIONAL RECYCLING COMMISSION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The proposed National Recycling Commission shall be tasked to formulate national recycling policies and adopt programs for the promotion of recycling in the country as a means of conserving resources.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A NATIONAL JUNIOR POLICE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to establish a national junior police, composed of Filipino citizens between the ages of 15 and 20, who shall assist the local officials in the maintenance of peace and order and other related activities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL PUBLIC UTILITY AGENCIES AND COMPANIES OR CORPORATIONS, BOTH PUBLIC AND PRIVATE, TO REPAIR ANY DIGGING OR DESTRUCTION MADE IN THE COURSE OF THEIR INSTALLATION OR MAINTENANCE WORK
rows.abstract: The bill requires all utility agencies to  restore roads, streets, passageways, pathways or similar places to their prior status within 72 hours from completion of any work in the area. It further requires the punong barangay or the barangay secretary to issue a certificate that the repair work has been completed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NEW LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: New Labor Code of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"New Labor Code of the Philippines.\" Some of the salient features of the bill are: a) it declares labor only-contracting as unlawful; b) it more clearly defines the right of a regular employee to security of tenure; c) it distinguishes between temporary employment and employment without a definite period; and d) it aligns the right to strike with International Labor Organization standards.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.status: Substituted by HB02808

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A STAGGERED WORKING HOUR SCHEME IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to encourage employers in the private sector to adopt a flexible time scheme that would allow their employees to work for more than eight hours a day but not more than forty hours a week. It provides for the payment of overtime for work rendered beyond forty hours a week.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REWARD INFORMANTS WHO HELP IDENTIFY, LOCATE AND RECOVER ANY ILL-GOTTEN WEALTH OF THE LATE PRESIDENT FERDINAND E. MARCOS, AND HIS WIDOW, IMELDA R. MARCOS AND OTHER DEFENDANTS OR RESPONDENTS IN ILL-GOTTEN WEALTH CASES WHEREVER LOCATED AND BY WHOMSOEVER HELD AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill offers the following rewards to informants who help in the recovery of any Marcos ill-gotten wealth: 1) For individuals - a) 10% of the amount recovered if less than US$100 million; b) 7% of amount recovered if US$100 million but less than US$500 million; c) 5% of amount recovered if US$500 million and more; and 2) For juridical informants, 15% of amount recovered.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CHAPTER 2, TITLE V OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to exempt the family home from the payment of real property tax.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE MAGNA CARTA FOR BARANGAYS
rows.title_short: The Magna Carta for Barangays
rows.abstract: \"The Magna Carta for Barangays.\" The bill proposes the following, among others: a) that barangay officials be considered as regular employees; b) that every barangay be provided with the basic priorities like supply of potable water, schools, etc; and c) the automatic release of their share in national taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.abstract: The bill declares it unlawful for any person to possess a copy, or part of a copy of any questionnaire of the Bar examinations and for an examiner to allow any person to have access to a Bar questionnaire or part thereof or to divulge the contents of such questionnaire.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.abstract: \"National Book Development Trust Fund Act\".  The bill seeks to establish the Trust Fund to support and promote Filipino authorship especially in science and technology and in subject areas wherein locally authored books are few or non-existent.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-02-21, transmitted to on 2006-03-01 and received by the Senate on 2006-03-01

rows.title_short: The Re-Engineering Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Re-Engineering Act of 2004\".  The bill sets forth the re-engineering principles and guidelines for the planned re-engineering of the bureaucracy.  It prescribes the composition, and powers and functions of the Commission.  It provides for a compensation package for government personnel who will be affected by the proposed re-engineering.

rows.title_short: Downstream Natural Gas Industry Development Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Downstream Natural Gas Industry Development Act of 2004\".  The bill seeks to provide a clear, comprehensive and integrated regulatory framework for the development of the nascent downstream natural gas industry.  It defines the responsibilities of the various government agencies and the private entities concerned.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05515

rows.author: C137
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE NATIONAL POWER CORPORATION TO ENSURE THE OPTIMUM UTILIZATION OF POWER SUPPLY WHICH THE GOVERNMENT HAS GUARANTEED TO PURCHASE FROM INDEPENDENT POWER PRODUCERS (IPPs), PROVIDING A POWER REBATE SYSTEM IN FAVOR OF THE CONSUMERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Power Rebate Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Power Rebate Act of 2004\".  The bill mandates the Manila Electric Company (MERALCO), the electric power cooperatives and distributors to give their consumers a monthly rebate of unutilized kilowatts.  The measure directs the Energy Regulatory Commission to formulate a system to determine the amount of rebate of utilized kilowatts based on the consumer's historical electric consumption.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLES 13, 40, 48, 52, 54 AND 99 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_full: THE BUDGET IMPOUNDMENT CONTROL ACT OF 2004
rows.title_short: The Budget Impoundment Control Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Impoundment\" refers to a refusal of the President, for whatever reason, to spend funds made available by Congress. The bill seeks to curtail the practice of presidential impoundments of funds by establishing a mechanism for Congress to review the deferral of releases prior to its exercise.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.title_short: The Philippine Research Development and Extension Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Philippine Research, Development and Extension Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to establish the Philcereal that shall develop and implement, in coordination with the University of the Philippines in Los Baños, a national research, development and extension program for rice, corn, wheat, sorghum, millet and other cereals.

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE LIABILITIES OF INDIRECT EMPLOYERS IN JOB CONTRACTING, COVERING OTHER BENEFITS DUE THEIR EMPLOYEES, FOR THIS PURPOSE AMENDING ARTICLE 106 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the indirect employers to ensure the payment of all benefits due employees hired through job contractors. It provides that if the employees can not get their benefits from their agencies, they can turn to the company for relief.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PRIVATE-HOSPITAL DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO PRIVATE HOSPITALS BY GRANTING THEM INCENTIVES
rows.title_short: Private Hospital Assistance Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Private Hospital Assistance Act of 2004.\" The bill proposes a Private Hospital Development Plan that shall monitor the needs of private hospitals in terms of facilities, equipment and personnel. It proposes the grant of tax incentives to accredited private hospitals and the creation of a Special Hospital Fund which shall be sourced from the real property taxes paid by private hospitals.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C029
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE SOLICITATION OF CONTRIBUTIONS FROM, OR SALE OF TICKETS TO, ANY GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL, OR EMPLOYEE BY ANY PUBLIC OFFICIAL, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3019, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits public officials and their relatives from soliciting contributions from or selling tickets to government employees receiving a salary of less than P15,000 a month.

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING INCENTIVES AND BENEFITS TO RURAL HEALTH UNIT DOCTORS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Rural Health Unit Doctors Benefits and Incentives Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Rural Health Unit Doctors Benefits and Incentives Act of 2004.\" In addition to incentives and benefits granted under existing laws, the bill seeks to grant rural health doctors the following: a) hazard allowance; b) subsistence allowance; c) scholarship up to the third legitimate child; d) income tax exemption; e) automatic promotion to the next higher position; f) free legal representation; and g) zero interest on policy, salary and housing loans from the GSIS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D086
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE RIGHT OF THE PEOPLE TO FREE EXPRESSION, PEACEABLY ASSEMBLE AND PETITION THE GOVERNMENT FOR REDRESS OF GRIEVANCES, REPEALING BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 880 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Freedom of Expression Act of 2004.
rows.abstract: \"The Freedom of Expression Act of 2004.\" The bill provides for the following: a) no permit requirement for the holding of a public assembly; b) non-interference from law enforcement authorities during public assemblies; c) extension of police assistance when requested; d) no dispersal of public assembly; and e) immunity from arrest and taxation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL, POLITICAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: D086
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-05-29, transmitted to on 2006-05-31 and received by the Senate on 2006-05-31
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AND PENALIZING THE CRIME OF ENFORCED OR INVOLUNTARY DISAPPEARANCE
rows.title_short: An Act Defining and Penalizing the Crime of Unforced or Involuntary Disappearance
rows.abstract: \"An Act Defining and Penalizing the Crime of Enforced or Involuntary Disappearance.\" The bill grants the victim of an enforced or involuntary disappearance the right to inform his family, lawyer or human rights organization of his whereabouts and condition. It also provides for penalties for the commission of enforced disappearance and for compensation and rehabilitation for the victims and their families.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04959

rows.author: D086
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MANDATORY NATIONWIDE CHILD NUTRITION PROGRAM IN ALL PUBLIC ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS AND BARANGAY DAY CARE CENTERS
rows.title_short: Child Nutrition Law of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Child Nutrition Law of 2004.\" The bill mandates the feeding of children enrolled in all public elementary schools and barangay day care centers in keeping with the State's policy of promoting and protecting the welfare of children.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09334) enacted on 2004-12-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 141, 142, 143 AND 145 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to restructure the tax on cigars and on distilled spirits, wines and fermented liquor by shifting to the ad valorem tax scheme.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03174

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SEC. 3 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8794 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: A076
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REIMPOSITION OF THE FRANCHISE TAX ON TELEPHONE AND TELEGRAPH COMPANIES, AND RADIO AND TELEVISION BROADCASTING COMPANIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 108 AND 119 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to remove telecommunications and broadcast companies from the ambit of the value-added tax system and to subject them to a franchise tax equivalent to 3.5% of the gross receipts on the first year of effectivity at this act and to 7% thereafter.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-12-06

rows.author: E033
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1638, KNOWN AS THE AFP MILITARY PERSONNEL RETIREMENT AND SEPARATION DECREE OF 1979
rows.title_short: Amending PD 1638, Known as the AFP Military Personnel Retirement and Separation Decree of 1979
rows.abstract: The bill grants retirement benefits to: a) a widow who married the retiree after his retirement and their children; and b) a retiree who acquires the citizenship of another country.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-04, transmitted to on 2006-04-06 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-06

second_reading.remarks: The Body approved to insert into the Record of the House the Explanatory Note of the bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.

rows.author: E033
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 340, AS AMENDED, WHICH ESTABLISHED A UNIFORM RETIREMENT SYSTEM FOR THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Amending RA 340, as Amended, Which Established a Uniform Retirement System for the AFP
rows.abstract: The bill extends retirement benefits to the unmarried widow of a veteran regardless of when the widow married the deceased veteran.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-04, transmitted to on 2006-04-06 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-06

second_reading.remarks: The Body adopted the Explanatory Note of the measure as the sponsorship remarks.

rows.author: D085
rows.title_full: BATAS NA NAGTATAKDA NG FILIPINO BILANG OPISYAL NA WIKA NG PAGTUTURO SA MGA PAARALAN
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the use of Filipino as the medium of instruction in all schools.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: E059
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING THE IMPOSITION OF FINES AND PENALTIES FOR CRIMES COMMITTED, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THIRTY-EIGHT HUNDRED AND FIFTEEN, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED, AND PRESIDENTIAL DECREES NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-THREE, AND SIXTEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Rationalizing the Imposition of Fines and Penalties for Crimes Committed
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to adjust the penalties provided under the Revised Penal Code that are grossly disproportionate to the amount or value of the subject of the offense and those that are ridiculously light considering the gravity of the offense. It also seeks the repeal of the provision penalizing vagrancy and prostitution.
rows.status: Printed copies distributed to members on 2007-06-04

second_reading.remarks: On Dec. 20, 2006, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure; approved the amendments as contained in the Ctte. Rpt., if any; and approved the same on Seond Reading.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OVERSEAS FILIPINO BANK AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: An Act Establishing the Overseas Filipino Bank
rows.abstract: \"An Act Establishing the Overseas Filipino Bank.\" The proposed Bank shall address the banking, economic, financial and related needs of overseas Filipino workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC SUCCESSION OF THE ASSOCIATE APPELLATE JUSTICE WHO IS FIRST IN PRECEDENCE TO POSITION OF PRESIDING APPELLATE JUSTICE OF THE COURT OF APPEALS IN CASE 0F VACANCY AND THE REMOVAL BY IMPEACHMENT OF THE MEMBERS THEREOF, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE JUDICIARY REORGANIZATION ACT
rows.abstract: The bill stipulates the appointment of the next-in-rank Associate Justice to the position of the Presiding Appellate Justice of the Court of Appeals (CA) in case of vacancy. It also provides for the removal from office of the members of the CA through impeachment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2005-06-07, transmitted to on 2005-07-25 and received by the Senate on 2005-08-03
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 31 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6770, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE OMBUDSMAN ACT OF 1989\"' AS AMENDED, ALLOWING LAWYERS TO ACT AS SPECIAL INVESTIGATOR OR PROSECUTOR ON BEHALF OF THE OMBUDSMAN
rows.abstract: The bill allows the Ombudsman to seek the assistance of private lawyers in handling cases against misfits in public office.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04275

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT CHANGING THE NAME OF ORAS NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ORAS, PROVINCE OF EASTERN SAMAR, INTO FEDERICO O. MENGOTE NATIONAL  MEMORIAL HIGH SCHOOL
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE MATARINAO SCHOOL OF FISHERIES IN BARANGAY MATARINAO, MUNICIPALITY OF SALCEDO, PROVINCE OF EASTERN SAMAR, INTO A FISHERY AND AGRICULTURAL INSTITUTE TO BE KNOWN AS THE MATARINAO SCHOOL OF FISHERY AND AGRICULTURE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING SQUATTING SYNDICATE, PROFESSIONAL SQUATTING, AND LARGE-SCALE LAND GRABBING AS HEINOUS CRIMES AND PROVIDING THE IMPOSITION OF THE DEATH PENALTY THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to declare the following as heinous crimes: a) participation in squatting syndicates; b) professional squatting; c) large-scale land grabbing; and d) the manufacture of fake titles and other related documents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE WITNESS PROTECTION, SECURITY AND BENEFIT PROGRAM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6981, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"WITNESS PROTECTION, SECURITY AND BENEFIT ACT\" AND PROVIDING ADDITIONAL FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill provides, among others, the following: a) the establishment of an organic security for the Witness Protection, Security and Benefits Program; b) the imposition on the witness of a separate criminal liability for violation of the Memorandum of Agreement; and c) limits the extension of rights and benefits to relatives within the first degree of consanguinity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 12 AND 13 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7662 ENTITLED \"AN ACT PROVIDING FOR REFORMS IN LEGAL EDUCATION, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE A LEGAL EDUCATION BOARD, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to amend the objectionable provisions in RA 7662 that have derailed the full enforcement of the law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE FAKING OF FABRICATING, KNOWINGLY NEGOTIATING, TRANSACTING, CONVEYING OR MORTGAGING OF FAKE OR FABRICATED TORRENS CERTIFICATE OF TITLE  A SPECIAL CRIME AND IMPOSING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the imposition of the penalty of reclusion temporal and a fine ranging from PhP100,000 to PhP150,000 on individuals found guilty of faking or fabricating Torrens Certificates of Title or of using, knowingly, fake and spurious documents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C069
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09406) enacted on 2007-03-23
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PUBLIC ATTORNEY'S OFFICE (PAO) AS AN INDEPENDENT AND AUTONOMOUS OFFICE, AMENDING THE PURPOSE CERTAIN SECTIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292 ENTITLED, \"ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987\"' AND FOR OTHER PURPOSE
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the powers, functions and organizational structure of the Public Attorney's Office, which shall be an autonomous office attached to the Department of Justice.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05921

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE MANNER OF REMOVAL OF THE PRESIDING JUSTICE AND ASSOCIATE JUSTICES OF THE SANDIGANBAYAN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1606, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the Presiding Justice and the Associate Justices to be removed from office in any manner provided for in Section 11 of Article VIII of the 1987 Constitution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING MARCH 16 OF EVERY YEAR AS A SPECIAL DAY IN THE NATIONAL CALENDAR TO COMMEMORATE THE DISCOVERY OF THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO BY FERDINAND MAGELLAN AND A SPECIAL NONWORKING DAY IN THE EASTERN VISAYAS REGION

rows.abstract: The bill seeks to rationalize the manner in which a public officer can be preventively suspended in office while a valid information is pending against him without, however, prejudicing the interest of the State and the general public.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE GOVERNMENT OR ANY OF ITS INSTRUMENTALITY, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT-OWNED OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS, FROM INTRODUCING OR CONSTRUCTING ANY KIND OF IMPROVEMENT ON PROPERTIES CONDITIONALLY COVEYED BY PRIVATE PERSONS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill defines \"conditionally conveyed properties\" as any property, real or personal, that a private person, natural or juridical, transfers to the government or any of its instrumentalities by way of donation, trust, assignment, usufruct, and other gratuitious mode of transferring ownership that imposes any condition where violation thereof shall result to the reversion of ownership or title to the private person.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF MINING ENGINEERING IN THE PHILIPPINES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO.4274
rows.title_short: Philippine Mining Engineering Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Mining Engineering Act of 2003.\" The bill seeks  to amend and update the Mining Engineering Law, which was enacted in 1965, to make it more realistic, relevant and practicable to current professional practice of mine engineers. It also embodies provisions to reduce or eliminate illegal mining practices in mines and quarries.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05686

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FURTHER PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT, UTILIZATION AND COMMERCIALIZATION OF RENEWABLE ENERGY SOURCES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Renewable Energy Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"Renewable Energy Act of 2003.\" The bill provides the framework for the exploration, development and utilization of the country's renewable energy sources, encourage their commercial applications and promote their efficient use.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05563

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING FEBRUARY FOUR OF EVERY YEAR AS \"ARAW NG PAGDAKILA SA MGA PILIPINONG NAGBUWIS NG BUHAY NOONG DIGMAANG PILIPINO-AMERIKANO\", PROVIDING FOR SUPPORT PROGRAMS, AND REQUIRING THE APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS THEREFOR

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8436 ENTITLED \"AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMISSION OF ELECTIONS TO USE AN AUTOMATED ELECTION SYSTEM IN THE MAY 11, 1998 NATIONAL OR LOCAL ELECTIONS AND IN SUBSEQUENT NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTORAL EXERCISES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to delete the requirement for an optical mark reader counting machine provided under RA 8436. It also allows the storage of election data in compact disc drives and compact discs. Finally, it authorizes the Commission on Elections to acquire the necessary materials for elections by \"purchase, lease or otherwise.\"
rows.status: Substituted by HB05352

rows.title_full: AN ACT HARMONIZING AND RATIONALIZING THE ADMINISTRATION AND GRANT OF FISCAL AND NONFISCAL INCENTIVES, REPEALING FOR THIS PURPOSE EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 226, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS INVESTMENTS CODE OF 1987
rows.title_short: The Investments and Incentives Code of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"The Investments and Incentives Code of the Philippines.\" The bill seeks to harmonize and simplify the grant of fiscal and non-fiscal incentives to promote foreign and domestic investments in the country. The incentives being proposed, among others, are: income tax holiday, net operating loss carry over, 5% tax based on gross income, accelerated depreciation, capital equipment incentives and deferred imposition of the minimum corporate income tax.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03295

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL REVENUE AUTHORITY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Revenue Authority Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"National Revenue Authority Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to restructure the Bureau of Internal Revenue into a semi-autonomous revenue authority with corporate-like features. It provides for capitalization, powers, functions and organizational structure of the Authority.
